availableCommands.name: debug
availableCommands.description: Debug your current Claude Code session by reading the session debug log. (bundled)

availableCommands.name: audit
availableCommands.description: Comprehensive codebase audit for release readiness. Parallel exploration of docs, code, config, tests, and specs to identify cruft, then interactive triage with clear action options. (project)

availableCommands.name: codex
availableCommands.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or wants Codex to review PRs, plans, or specs. Delegates to GPT-5.3-codex with preset reasoning modes. (project)

availableCommands.name: e2e
availableCommands.description: E2E testing patterns for kspec web UI. Use when writing Playwright tests, debugging hydration issues, or working with daemon fixtures. (project)

availableCommands.name: eval-agents
availableCommands.description: Evaluate whether AGENTS.md provides enough context for agents to make correct decisions. Spawns test agents with scenario questions and grades responses. (project)

availableCommands.name: local-review
availableCommands.description: Pre-PR quality review - verify AC coverage, test quality, E2E preference, and test isolation. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr
availableCommands.description: Create a pull request from current work. Handles branch creation, commits, push, and PR creation. Detects branch protection and guides through the PR workflow. (project)

availableCommands.name: pr-review
availableCommands.description: Review a PR linked to a kspec task, post findings as inline comments, and merge only when all quality gates pass. You NEVER fix code — you review and comment. If issues found, kick back to worker. (project)

availableCommands.name: release
availableCommands.description: Create versioned releases - bump version via PR, tag, create GitHub release. CI publishes to npm. (project)

availableCommands.name: svelte-5
availableCommands.description: Svelte 5 patterns, gotchas, and solutions. Use when working with Svelte 5/SvelteKit, especially for reactivity, SSR, and state management issues. (project)

availableCommands.name: create-workflow
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Formalize repeatable patterns into trackable kspec workflows. Design steps, choose triggers, create loop variants, and integrate with skills.

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Get help with kspec commands and workflows

availableCommands.name: observe
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Capture and act on systemic patterns — friction, successes, questions, and ideas. The feedback loop that drives process improvement.

availableCommands.name: plan
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Translate approved plans into specs and tasks. Import structured documents or create incrementally. Plans persist as durable artifacts with audit trail.

availableCommands.name: reflect
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured reflection at the end of work sessions. Identifies learnings, friction points, and improvements for system evolution.

availableCommands.name: review
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Kspec-specific review gates — spec alignment, own AC coverage, trait AC coverage, and validation integration. Building block for project-specific review workflows.

availableCommands.name: task-work
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Structured task lifecycle — start, work, note, submit, complete. Fix cycle handling, scope management, loop mode for automation, and quality gates.

availableCommands.name: triage
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Triage inbox items systematically. Records decisions with audit trail, then executes actions. Supports inbox, observations, and automation eligibility triage.

availableCommands.name: triage-automation
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Assess and prepare tasks for automation eligibility. Verify spec coverage, acceptance criteria, and task readiness for automated agents.

availableCommands.name: triage-inbox
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Process inbox items using the record-act pattern. Categorize, promote to spec/task, merge duplicates, defer, or delete stale items with full audit trail.

availableCommands.name: writing-specs
availableCommands.description: (kspec) Create and maintain specification items — modules, features, requirements, acceptance criteria, and traits. The source of truth for what to build.

availableCommands.name: compact
availableCommands.description: Clear conversation history but keep a summary in context. Optional: /compact [instructions for summarization]

availableCommands.name: context
availableCommands.description: Show current context usage

availableCommands.name: init
availableCommands.description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation

availableCommands.name: pr-comments
availableCommands.description: Get comments from a GitHub pull request

availableCommands.name: review
availableCommands.description: Review a pull request

availableCommands.name: security-review
availableCommands.description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

availableCommands.name: insights
availableCommands.description: Generate a report analyzing your Claude Code sessions

Implement Validation and Alignment View
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KJXSVK0M6DHDVPA9J4G9XD1G
Slugs:     implement-validation-and-alignment-view
Type:      task
Status:    needs_work
Priority:  3
Automation: eligible
Spec ref:  @ui-validation-view
Plan ref:  @plan-ui-ux-revamp
Depends:
  @implement-app-shell-and-navigation → Implement App Shell and Navigation [completed]
Created:   2026-03-05T01:30:06.740Z
Started:   2026-03-06T06:09:05.663Z

─── Spec Context ───
Validation and Alignment View
Type: feature
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  View showing validation results, alignment statistics, and issues.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: The user navigates to /validate

    When: Validation data loads

    Then: Summary shows error count, warning count, valid item count.
Alignment section shows spec coverage %, AC coverage %,
orphaned tasks/specs counts. Issues list grouped by severity.


─── Notes ───
[2026-03-05T01:30:06.740Z] @claude:
See plan @plan-ui-ux-revamp for implementation notes
[2026-03-05T20:51:48.374Z] @claude:
Implemented Validation and Alignment View at /validate route.

Approach:
- Added fetchValidation() and fetchAlignment() API functions to api.ts with full TypeScript types mirroring daemon response shapes
- Built single-page component with three sections: summary cards (errors/warnings/overall status), alignment stats (spec coverage %, alignment %, orphaned specs, warnings), and issues list grouped by severity (errors > warnings > info)
- Issues are aggregated from both validation (schema errors, ref errors, trait cycles, completeness warnings, orphans) and alignment (status mismatches, orphaned specs, stale implementations) APIs
- Includes loading skeleton, error banner, empty state, and refresh button
- Static mode returns empty/valid defaults (read-only)
- Uses Svelte 5 runes exclusively (, , .by)
- Follows existing patterns from observations/dashboard pages
- Sidebar nav entry already existed at /validate with ShieldCheck icon
- All data-testid attributes for future E2E testing

Files changed:
- packages/web-ui/src/lib/api.ts — Added validation/alignment types and fetch functions
- packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte — Full page implementation
[2026-03-05T22:16:08.282Z] Jacob Chapel:
Review findings: MUST-FIX 1) No test covers @ui-validation-view ac-1. The only AC annotations are in implementation files at packages/web-ui/src/lib/api.ts:808 and packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:2, and the branch changes no test files. 2) Spec mismatch in packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:60, 341-357, and 362-431: validItemCount is computed but never rendered, and the alignment section shows Alignment plus orphaned specs and warnings instead of the required AC coverage % and orphaned tasks/specs counts from @ui-validation-view ac-1. 3) Design-token gate failed in packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:235,240,263,314,329,345,383,399,449,455,479,485,509,515,540 because the page uses raw Tailwind colors like bg-red-50, text-yellow-600, bg-emerald-500, and bg-blue-50 instead of design tokens. Regression check passed: npm test and packages/web-ui npm test both exited 0.
[2026-03-05T22:16:10.037Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 1] Review findings: Review issues: missing AC test coverage; validate view misses required valid item count / AC coverage / orphaned tasks data from @ui-validation-view ac-1; raw Tailwind colors used instead of design tokens.
[2026-03-05T22:52:50.110Z] @claude:
Fix cycle 1: Addressed all three MUST-FIX items from review.

1. AC test coverage: Added 13 E2E tests (validate.spec.ts) covering summary cards, alignment section, issues list grouped by severity, loading/empty/error states, and navigation. All annotated with // AC: @ui-validation-view ac-1.

2. Spec mismatch fixes:
   - Replaced 'Overall Status' card with 'Valid Items' card showing actual count (total items minus items with errors)
   - Replaced 'Alignment %' with 'AC Coverage %' (computed from missing_test_coverage completeness warnings)
   - Replaced 'Alignment Warnings' with 'Orphaned Tasks' (tasks without spec_ref)
   - Kept 'Orphaned Specs' (already correct)

3. Design token gate:
   - Added severity tokens (error/warning/info/success) to design system tokens.css with light/dark mode variants using oklch color space
   - Added Tailwind theme extensions for severity tokens in app.css
   - Replaced all raw Tailwind colors (bg-red-50, text-yellow-600, bg-emerald-500, bg-blue-50, etc.) with semantic severity tokens

Additional: Added /validate plus other missing routes to daemon SPA fallback routes.
[2026-03-06T00:56:21.931Z] Jacob Chapel:
Review findings: MUST-FIX 1) packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:57-71 computes "Valid Items" by subtracting unique schemaErrors.file, refErrors.ref, and traitCycles.traitRef values from totalItemCount. Those identifiers are not equivalent to invalid items, so the summary can miscount valid items; packages/web-ui/tests/e2e/validate.spec.ts:214-245 locks in the same incorrect math by asserting "2 errors => 8 valid items." 2) packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:82-96 computes "AC Coverage %" as (total items - itemsWithMissingCoverage) / total items and explicitly says it uses totalItems "for simplicity." That is not acceptance-criteria coverage; it is item-level approximation. packages/web-ui/tests/e2e/validate.spec.ts:283-292 bakes in the same wrong behavior by expecting 90% from 10 total items and 1 uncovered item. 3) packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:283-305 uses raw animate-pulse placeholders instead of the design-system shimmer utility in packages/web-ui/src/lib/ds/animations.css:1-65, so the async loading state misses the required shimmer pattern and reduced-motion gating from the review checklist. Regression check passed: npm test exited 0 at repo root, and packages/web-ui npm test exited 0.
[2026-03-06T00:56:23.316Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 2] Review findings: Review issues: validation view shows incorrect valid-item and AC-coverage metrics, and its loading state does not use the required shimmer/reduced-motion pattern.
[2026-03-06T06:18:14.800Z] @claude:
Fix cycle 2: Addressed all three MUST-FIX items from review.

1. Valid Items count: Changed from using refErrors.ref (the broken target reference) to sourceUlid/sourceFile (the item containing the broken reference). This correctly identifies which items have validation errors instead of counting nonexistent targets.

2. AC Coverage %: Replaced item-level approximation with actual AC-level computation. Now sums acceptance_criteria_count from the items API (total ACs = 20 in test data) and parses uncovered ACs from completeness warning details field. Coverage = (totalACs - uncoveredACs) / totalACs. Display also shows 'N/M ACs with tests' for transparency.

3. Loading skeleton: Replaced all animate-pulse classes with ds-shimmer utility from lib/ds/animations.css, which provides proper shimmer animation with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) gating.

Files changed:
- packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte — All three metric/skeleton fixes
- packages/web-ui/tests/e2e/validate.spec.ts — Updated mock items with acceptance_criteria_count, adjusted AC coverage assertion from 90% to 95%
[2026-03-06T15:21:48.362Z] Jacob Chapel:
Review findings: MUST-FIX 1) AC Coverage is undercounting uncovered trait ACs. In packages/web-ui/src/routes/validate/+page.svelte:239-247, countUncoveredACs() only parses details matching '^Uncovered: ...', but trait coverage warnings are emitted as 'Uncovered trait ACs: ...' (src/parser/validate.ts:1050). This inflates displayed AC coverage whenever trait AC gaps exist. Add parsing for trait warning format and add an E2E assertion covering trait_ac warnings. 2) kspec validate still reports a warning for this spec: 'Validation and Alignment View status is in_progress but should be not_started' (kspec validate output lines 52-53). Per review checklist, warnings for this spec are blocker-level and must be resolved before merge.
[2026-03-06T15:21:54.015Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 3] Review findings: Review issues: AC coverage % currently ignores uncovered trait AC warnings in /validate view; kspec validate still reports a spec-specific warning for @ui-validation-view (status mismatch).
